text: ZYN is a brand within Philip Morris International's portfolio; the Ferrari partner page describes ZYN as a leading oral nicotine pouch brand within PMI's combustion-free portfolio, available in more than 60 markets.
short: ZYN is a brand within Philip Morris International's portfolio (NYSE: PM).

source.name: Ferrari – ZYN Premium Partner page
source.quote: ZYN is a leading oral nicotine pouch brand within Philip Morris International’s conbustion-free portfolio, offering a valid tobacco-free alternative to cigarettes for adult consumers.
